description:
Overview 

 As a Product Engineer on the ArcGIS Pro Sharing team, you will help shape how GIS professionals publish their work, collaborate with others, and bring authoritative content to ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise, and related apps. This role is a blend of product thinking, technical investigation, and hands-on validation. You will work closely with developers, product engineers, and other teams to understand real user workflows, explore edge cases, improve product quality, and help turn complex sharing scenarios into reliable, intuitive product capabilities.

 Bring your interest in web GIS, product quality, and user-centered workflows to the ArcGIS Pro Sharing team!

 Responsibilities 

 
 Design, develop, and maintain automated tests for ArcGIS Pro sharing workflows, with a focus on product quality, regression coverage, and release readiness

 Build test coverage for workflows that share GIS content to ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise

 Analyze customer scenarios and product requirements to identify expected behavior, edge cases, and areas where automated validation is needed

 Investigate test failures and product issues, communicate findings clearly, and help drive defects to resolution

 Work with developers and product teams to refine sharing workflows and ensure new capabilities are testable, reliable, and ready for release

 Support documentation, messaging, and user-facing workflows by validating behavior and helping clarify how users share GIS content successfully

 
 Requirements 

 
 1+ years of related C# programming experience for automated test development

 Experience testing or troubleshooting software features in a collaborative development environment

 Ability to evaluate workflows from a user perspective and translate requirements into clear test plans and product feedback

 Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to investigate complex software behavior

 Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, design, documentation, and product teams

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, GIS, geography, or a related field

 
 Recommended Qualifications 

 
 Experience with ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise, or other GIS products

 Familiarity with web GIS concepts, including web maps, services, REST APIs, or JSON

 Experience with automated testing frameworks, continuous integration systems, or software quality processes

 Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, GIS, geography, or a related field

 
 #LI-EL1

 #LI-Onsite
 Total Rewards 

 Esri’s competitive total rewards strategy includes industry-leading health and welfare benefits: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance for employees (and their families), 401(k) and profit-sharing programs, minimum accrual of 80 hours of vacation leave, twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year, and opportunities for personal and professional growth. Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

 A reasonable estimate of the base salary range is
 $70,304 — $109,200 USD 


 The Company 

 At Esri, diversity is more than just a word on a map. When employees of different experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and cultures come together, we are more innovative and ultimately a better place to work.
